# XeooAuditor

> XeooAuditor is a privacy-first public website auditing toolkit. It enables visitors to submit public URLs, run security and technical compliance checks, and export reports without creating accounts or storing personal credentials.

## Public Pages
- Website Homepage: https://xeooauditor.xo.je/
- Contact & Responsible Disclosure: https://xeooauditor.xo.je/contact

## Core Auditing Capabilities
- SSL / TLS Certificate and Protocol Inspection
- HTTP Security Response Headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, Permissions-Policy)
- DNS and Server Resolution Security
- Robots.txt and Sitemap.xml Structure Validation

## Privacy & Security Model
- No visitor registration or account creation required.
- Zero cookie-based visitor profiling or third-party tracking scripts.
- Target URL scans are strictly bounded and protected against Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) via pre-flight DNS validation and cURL IP pinning.
- Administrator functions are segregated with single-active session controls and rate-limited authentication.

## Contact & Vulnerability Reporting
For inquiries, reproducible bug reports, or responsible security disclosures, visit https://xeooauditor.xo.je/contact.
